However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.

4. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) The DG sets AMC service has to be provided onsite at the site of installation in RMCDC Yerawada, Pune, Maharashtra. 2) Both the DG sets are 11 years old, the bidders shall quote the AMC cost considering the age of the DG s ets. 3) This is a comprehensive contract, the cost for all repairs/ replacements/ servicing within the contract pe riod shall be borne by the firm to whom the AMC work is allotted, nothing extra shall be paid for keeping t he DG sets in healthy condition. 4) The DG sets shall be handed over to the qualified bidder in working condition & it will be taken back in s ame condition on completion of contract period. 5) In case any dispute, buyer reserve the right to terminate the contract on immediate basis. 6) The contract will be valid for a period of two year from the date of awarding of the contract, which may be extended for a further period of one year or part thereof if the performance/ services found satisfactory, on the same rates at the same terms and conditions depending upon the requirement and administrative c onvenience of this office. 7)The Comprehensive AMC of DG Sets, shall include the following services: 1. AMC Services 2. B Check Servicing (including filters, lubricant oil and coolant) of each DG set once a year as per requi rement 3. Supply of 12v, 150Ah battery for each DG Set (Total 2 Nos) as per requirement 8) The total bid cost quoted by the bidder should comprise the comprehensive sum of all above three servi ces. 9) Furthermore, the bid should provide a detailed breakdown of the service costs for AMC Services, B Chec k Servicing of each DG set, and the supply of batteries. This breakdown allows for flexibility in availing addi tional services if needed, at the quoted rates. 10) All faults which affect the functioning of DG set are to be rectified within 24 hours of registering the co mplaints and rest faults within 72 hours. Following penalty would be levied for failure in timely carrying out rectification of fault over and above the amount incurred in rectification of fault. § 1st violation in a year - 5% of total annual maintenance contract § 2nd violation in a year - 10% of total annual maintenance contract § 3rd violation in a year onwards - 10% of total annual maintenance contract or cancellation of Contract an d forfeiting of PBG.

In case any dispute, buyer reserve the right to terminate the contract on immediate basis. . 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Chief Account Officer (Cash), O/o. Controller Of Communication Accounts, Maharashtra , 3rd Floor, BSNL A dmin Building, Juhu Road, Santacruz West, Mumbai-400054 (Chief Account Officer Cash) A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
